about_the_game:
🏷️ Short Description

Dungeon Brawl is a casual-yet-intense online co-op roguelike action game! Choose from dozens of anime-style heroes, freely combine hundreds of skills and relics, and team up with your friends to carve through hordes of enemies. Build your own fighting style and dive into the blood-soaked chaos!

🧭 About This Game

👾 Anime Heroes × Roguelike Builds × Hack & Slash Action

Welcome to Dungeon Brawl — a fast-paced, anime-style co-op roguelike that combines the skillful controls of MOBAs with deep build crafting mechanics. Every run is a new adventure, every battle a chaotic thrill!

💥 A New Challenge Every Run!

  • Dozens of stylized anime heroes with unique skills and personalities

  • Hundreds of skills to mix and match — unlock synergies, evolve combos, and build your own battle rhythm

  • Collect hundreds of randomized relics and gear every run to customize your build

  • Deep strategy meets fast-paced action — showcase your creativity every time you play

🧙 Diverse Playstyles — Your Build, Your Way!

From brawlers to mages, summoners to tanks, you’ll find your flow in Dungeon Brawl:

  • ⚔️ Physical: Dash in and slash your enemies into pieces

  • 🔥 Spellcaster: Unleash powerful AoE and elemental blasts

  • ✨ Effect-heavy: Stack poison, burn, and shock for massive damage over time

  • 🛡️ Tank/Defense: Soak up hits, protect teammates

  • 👻 Summoner: Command minions to fight for you

  • 🐉 Transformation: Morph into powerful creatures and wreak havoc

🤝 Easy to Learn, Exciting to Master — With Friends!

  • Up to 4-player online co-op

  • Supportive synergy mechanics: shield, heal, crowd control, buffs — teamwork matters!

  • Players choose their own challenge routes and difficulty to gain greater rewards

  • Designed to be easy to pick up, fun to repeat, and wildly satisfying to master

📅 Release Info

  • Game Title: Dungeon Brawl

  • Genre: Online Co-op / Action Roguelike / Skill-Based Building

  • Platform: Steam / PC (keyboard, mouse, and controller supported)

  • Planned Release: Q4 2025

📌 Add to your wishlist now to get notified about upcoming tests and full release!

"We're a small indie team passionate about anime and action games. Dungeon Brawl is our tribute to chaotic fun, deep strategy, and the joy of co-op mayhem!"
